messages:
nayan (product): Quick announcement — we're shipping two coordinated changes next month: a new invoice CSV schema (v2) and a 6-week "soft burst allowance" pilot for new customers. Both are targeted at reducing confusion and support load for high-burst onboarding. TL;DR: dry-run meter reporting starts 2026-04-07, schema switch + optional customer opt-in pilot starts 2026-05-01. More below.

andre (eng-billing): Thanks. High level on eng side: we'll gate CSV v2 behind the feature flag billing_csv_v2. We'll emit both schemas for the 3-week transition window and set the new header by default after 2026-05-01. We also have a rollout toggle for the soft-burst pilot per-tenant.

andre (eng-billing): Dev notes: sample v2 header is:```
invoice_id,customer_id,billing_period_start,billing_period_end,region,route,token_count,unit_price_usd,adjustments,total_amount_usd,burst_allowance_seconds
```
The only breaking change is consolidating line-level price columns and adding burst_allowance_seconds (nullable). Please update parsers.

oliver (finance): Heads-up for finance ops: we'll keep both CSVs for 30 days in the export UI and SFTP bundles. Please do a reconciliation dry-run during April and escalate mismatches to #finance ASAP. We'll publish a field mapping cheat-sheet.

sophie (support): For CS/Support: what should we tell customers who report "missing fields" once v2 goes live? Do we treat April as dry-run (no billing impact)?

nayan (product): Good Q — April dry-run = telemetry only, no billing differences. Customers will see a banner in the Console if they're in the pilot and get an email. CS script: short answer: "we're rolling out a new invoice CSV format that will coexist with the old one in April — no billing changes during the dry-run." Link to playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/billing-v2-playbook (internal).

maria (sales): Need a customer-friendly one-liner for AE email templates. Suggestion: "We're improving invoice clarity — you may see a new CSV layout during April, no action required unless you use automated parsers."",

andre (eng-billing): Implementation note: we'll add a response header X-Redwood-Invoice-Format: v2 when the new CSV is served. Also exporting SFTP paths will be suffixed with /v2/ while we keep /v1/ intact.

billing-bot: export job completed for tenant: acme-corp - /exports/invoices/2026-04-02/v1/invoice_2155551200.csv :white_check_mark:

oliver (finance): Please watch for edge cases: marketplace resells and tax_adjustment lines — those used to be separate rows and will now be inline adjustments. We'll coordinate with tax ops.

sophie (support): Can we add a quick checklist for support to triage parser errors? e.g., check header, check suffix v1/v2 path, check X-Redwood-Invoice-Format.

nayan (product): Yes — added to the playbook. Action items: (1) Eng: rollout plan + feature flag (owner: andre) (2) CS/Support: update canned responses and triage checklist (owner: sophie) (3) Finance: reconciliation dry-run and mapping sheet (owner: oliver) (4) Sales: one-liner/email snippet (owner: maria). Timeline in the playbook.

maria (sales): Will update AE templates and send to marketing for the customer banner copy.

andre (eng-billing): Rolling out flag to staging now. Will post status in #eng-billing and tag when we flip to dual-emission for the April dry-run.

nayan (product): Super — thanks all. If you spot anything risky in the mapping, ping me directly. Expect a short announcement to customers the week of 2026-04-01. :spiral_calendar:
